verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents AI-generated summaries or recaps of missed channels or threads. The closest items are adjacent: agents that search history and post the matching threads, a generic @mention-prompted agent harness, and a personalized feed. A user could ask an agent for a recap, but none of these is a documented summarization or catch-up capability.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can get AI-generated summaries and recaps of channels and threads I missed
